identification: Keen's Genuine Tasmanian Curry Powder lidded tin canister, navy/gold with prize medals, 8 cm, 'Browns River, Kingston' (4 photos). Keen's Curry was made in Tasmania from 1860s; early tins are Tasmanian collectables.
